hotels.description: Escape to Singapore’s most coveted rainforest sanctuary, where eco-luxury entwines effortlessly with untamed wilderness, just 25 minutes from the city. Nestled within the prestigious Mandai Wildlife Reserve, a world-renowned nature and wildlife reserve with zoological parks in spades, this five-star resort offers the perfect retreat for families and couples alike, home to spacious family rooms and secluded tree-top suites, each boasting exquisite interiors and towering windows that frame the verdant oasis beyond. You're enveloped by tropical greenery yet moments from Singapore's crown jewels - the legendary Singapore Zoo, mystical Night Safari and enchanting River Wonders wildlife park. Back onsite, take time to lounge by the glorious rooftop pool while the little ones are looked after at the colourful Rangers' Club. Indulge your senses at the award-winning Forage restaurant, where locally sourced, seasonal ingredients transform into culinary masterpieces, and unwind with bespoke treatments and botanical therapies at the world-renowned Banyan Tree Spa. The all-day Planter's Shed offers casual dining, while nearby forest trails and wildlife encounters create unforgettable memories just beyond your suite.
